caption: Kar. 1. Altar
labels: sic, by line 2 (over the divider in sore : yi)
altered, by line 3 (over the 4-sign at the end of line 3)
notes: Line 3: first sign hatched, a 3-form (m, ẖ or s); the end 'yi' is the altered stretch (4-sign with //), could be read otherwise. Line 4 'qo': 3-form + slash read as q, could be s+o or ẖ+y. Line 5: 'sse' = closed 3 then se (U with //); next sign a ) cut by the break edge, read m?. Line 8 (shrine): sign after a is an open angle, read as a variant of to; the sign after b is a flat-topped 3 (ẖ?); m/ẖ by tail length. Line 9 (spout): d? is an N-like sign (d or n). All 52-pairs read a by context (could be k+e).

caption: Kar. 2. Stela with man and woman (Kar. Cem., Pl. 11, C. 40229)
notes: Line numbers 2, 5 and 7 stand over the second sign of the word (r, to, t), as printed. s in soreyi and i, w in line 3-4 hatched. The 52-pairs are read a at word start and ke in pso-kete/psḫr-kete (same shape). 'q' = 3-form + slash, then a second slash = o.

caption: Kar. 2. Stela with man and woman (Kar. Cem., Pl. 11, C. 40229)
notes: Line 4 second sign hatched, N-like (d or n). to in line 8 is a small open curve with a dot. Continues in the part 'between legs'.

notes: Own line numbers 1 and 2. Line 2 is hatched for about four sign widths; only a 7/3-like hook is visible in the hatching, read k? (expected ke-te from the formula, not verified).
